description: Employees of a government civil engineering department hold a meeting in their office, discussing work around a table with plans or documents, led by someone at the head of the table or at the front of the room.
Staff at the counter of a neighbourhood grocery shop serve customers by handing over, weighing and packing goods and taking payment, while other customers wait their turn.
Job candidates wait in the waiting area of a corporate office for their turn to be interviewed, while office staff manage the process and interviews may be under way nearby.
Family members sow seeds in a kitchen garden, preparing the soil, placing seeds in it and watering the beds.
People collect water at a hand pump, operating the pump, filling containers, carrying filled containers away and waiting their turn with empty ones.
Family members tend a cow in a courtyard, milking it and feeding it fodder, grain or water.
Family members cook lunch together in their home kitchen, preparing ingredients and cooking food on the stove.
Family members clean their living room together, sweeping or mopping the floor, dusting and wiping furniture, and tidying belongings.
Family members feed and groom their pet dog in the living room, giving it food and brushing, wiping or bathing it.
Family members look after a newborn baby in their living room, holding, feeding, changing and soothing the baby and keeping it company.
Family members look after an unwell elderly relative at home, giving medicine and food, checking their health, making them comfortable and keeping them company.
Family members help a child with homework at home, explaining, guiding and checking the child's work.
Volunteers cook and serve free food to people in a neighbourhood, who queue for, receive and eat the food.
Volunteers clean up litter in a park, picking up rubbish, bagging it and sweeping paths.
Volunteers run a neighbourhood blood donation camp, registering donors, collecting blood with medical staff and giving donors refreshments.
Students carry out a science experiment in a school laboratory, handling apparatus and recording observations, with a teacher guiding them.
Students study in a college library, reading and writing at tables, discussing material in groups and finding books on the shelves, with library staff present.
College students assemble a robot in a robotics lab, building its mechanical parts, wiring its electronics and programming it.
Relatives gather in a home and chat with each other over tea and snacks.
Residents of a housing society hold a meeting in the society hall, with office-bearers leading from the front and residents speaking and listening.
Family members perform evening prayers together at their home shrine, with lamp-waving and offerings, bell-ringing, singing or chanting, and silent worship.
People play a football game or practice on an open ground, with players, possibly a referee or coach, and spectators.
Family members sit together in their living room watching a cricket match on TV.
People play musical instruments together in a community hall, possibly with singers and a conductor, in front of an audience.
Members of a household do their skin care routine before going to bed, applying creams, lotions or masks to themselves or to each other.
Family members sleep together on a mattress in their bedroom at night, some possibly being settled to sleep by others.
Clients receive massages from therapists at a massage centre, with staff attending to them and other clients waiting their turn.
